## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change.

## Scope and impact

Explain affected behavior, compatibility, security boundaries, dependencies,
documentation, and any deliberate non-goals.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and their results. Explain documentation-only scope or
any check that could not be run.

## Provenance

Identify substantial third-party sources, templates, generated material, or
upstream work and confirm that required licences and attribution are preserved.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is within the repository's documented scope.
- [ ] Tests cover behavior changes, or the reason they are unnecessary is explained.
- [ ] Documented formatting, linting, type-checking, test, and build checks pass.
- [ ] User-facing documentation and release notes are updated where needed.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, customer information, or private vulnerability details are included.
- [ ] Licence, copyright, NOTICE, and attribution obligations are preserved.
- [ ] Security, compatibility, and maintenance effects are described.
